Little hidden gem of a cafe
Apr 2026 • Couples
Tonkin Village feels like a true hidden gem — tucked away inside an old apartment building, it’s one of those secret finds that makes exploring Ho Chi Minh City so special. 

Set within an 80+ year old building, the café has a beautiful, quiet atmosphere with a distinct 1940s charm. It’s a peaceful escape from the energy of District 1, perfect for slowing down and soaking it all in.

The menu is fantastic, especially if you love coffee — there are so many options to choose from. Each cup is not only delicious but also beautifully presented, showing real care and attention to detail. There is even vegan drinks and food options! 

If you’re looking for something a little different, with history, character, and exceptional coffee, Tonkin Village is absolutely worth seeking out. It was my go to cafe while I was visiting Saigon.

Egg Coffee
Jun 2025 • Family
Follow @breadgyeats for more food pics!

Through the hustle and bustle of the pulsing streets of Saigon, many – including me – find the time to relax with a comforting cup of coffee. A product of never-ending innovation, I’m lucky to experience egg coffee once more. Perhaps I was extra adventurous, or extra sleepy, so I ordered an extra shot for a richer, more intense version of this sweet treat. The egg foam had a refined, airy mouthfeel with a floral vanilla aroma and subtle egg custard flavour. This time, the coffee does the talking, bringing out the bold cocoa bitterness and deep chocolatey aroma, which is balanced with the mild sweetness of the egg cream. It's a more adult, roasted finish, although I'm sure a coffee lover would appreciate this drink.

🌎 With regards to the café, excellent! ⚖️🔻🕊️
Jan 2025 • Solo
🇵🇸 Pretty nice café up several flights of stairs accessed through a narrow corridor from the pavement, the ☕️ coffees which I've had have been reasonably priced and their menu has clearly labelled vegan options with oat milk, so no need to explain "no calves' milk, no condensed calves' milk, no milk foam etc". My iced drinks have also still had a very 🧕🏼⚖️ robust coffee taste, even after all the ice has been integrated into my beverage. And that's only with a single shot of espresso! I like this fact a lot🔻⚖️!! Unfortunately they don't have vegan food options, but no matter; eating something from a branch of "O Plant-based" is no trouble at all 🕌. The main seating is on the side overlooking the road below, and a small balcony area gives you the option of sitting outside should you care to🇿🇦⚖️. However, there is also an overfill room at the back - on the opposite side of the main section. This latter area is decent too although relatively small, only able to absorb three double seats and a bigger table that can stretch that number to five places. However, it's still good if you need or want to get some work or study done🌎🇵🇸. All in all, a great and 🇵🇸 welcoming 🕌 café, considering I was staying more or less around the corner.

Great coffee and great ambiance
Jun 2024 • Couples
Great place for Vietnamese coffee, tea and juices. The coffee shop is on the second floor of a building with a bit of a "seek and find" entrance, followed by a 2-story stair climb. Once you get there it turns out to be well worth it. The interior is very nice, friendly and very competent staff speaks English (which is not so common) and coffee selection and quality is great. 

Tonking serves high quality local coffee and teas - unlike other specialty places which have only imported beans. My husband and I really enjoyed the egg coffee and cold brew coffee with fresh coconut water. Presentation was beautiful, and taste was great. There is also food selection - although very limited vegetarian offer. 

Nice thing - they have oat milk (which is rare at Vietnamese shops).

Tonkin Coffee - a great little hidden coffee shop in HCMC

In April 2024 I visited Vietnam with my son. While we were there, like so many other tourists and locals alike, we both fell in love with Vietnamese coffee and sought out various coffee shops across the country to try their version of the national drink. Tonkin Coffee in HCMC offered some of the absolute best coffee we had during our 3-week stay in Vietnam. We tried out their milk and egg coffees – both were delicious, so much so that we ordered a second coffee while we were there. As we were also hungry when we got to the coffee shop, we had some of their pastries and banh mi. Both were excellent! I should also mention the outstanding friendly service at the café as well. This literal hole in the wall café is located down a long alley hallway and up a flight of stairs, but it is well worth seeking out. I highly recommend this wonderful little coffee shop!

I had read about Tonkin so went on the search and yes at first a little hard to find but that’s the beauty of this place, so many hidden gems in the least expected places. They had a choice of Arabica or Robusta cappuccino so I went for the Arabica which was delicious. Definitely the best cappuccino I’ve had in Saigon. I’ve been back several times and also tried their specialty Tonkin coffee which was also very good although I don’t usually drink my coffee sweet. Not a coffee kind of guy, more tea, or even better a few beers, but as was walking on the street and kind of looking for a place to sit down and waste an hour or two with my friend, for a chat, we happened to pass by two nice young people who were offering free samples of coffee........sure what the hell, we liked the coffee they offered and they were friendly so we ventured into their cafe.......down a long small alleyway and up and up and up some stairs to the coffee joint.......I must say it was a nice surprise as the place was very well decorated, and looked very nice with cool friendly chilled out vibes...... hats off to the interior decorator, good job!

Had a regular coffee and my friend went with some weird drink, don't ask me....look at pic....

Then tried their ‘Tonkin Brown’, which looked interesting and tasted very nice........although small.....(as i said I'm not a coffee drinker, ha)..........so i went for another one..... lovely chocolate taste and flavour on the tongue.....nice..

We spent an hour or so here, and chatted with the manager who was friendly.......

Really a lovely place, and I would love to return again, if i can notice it, as the entrance is so small it can be easy to miss.........but it is the type of gem that makes this city so great............Recommended place to while away an hour or so in a very relaxed setting.......
